chat_messages: Discussion: [System]: You have 3 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I was in the Reactor for most of the round, so I didn't see anyone near Security, but Ian's movement from Medbay to Upper Engine and then Security is definitely suspicious.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: I completely agree with Macroon, and since I'm currently in Communications with Oscar, I haven't seen Ian, but his route to Security is highly suspicious and I'm ready to back a vote against him.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Wait, Macroon, you said you were in the Reactor, but I saw you in the Cafeteria in Round 1 and then moving into Medbay in Round 3, so why are you lying about your location to frame Ian?
chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I agree with Alice; I saw Macroon in the Cafeteria during Round 1 and moving toward Medbay in Round 3, so why are they lying about being in the Reactor to frame Ian?
chat: Discussion: [Liam]: I can confirm Alice and Bob's observations because I also saw Macroon in the Cafeteria during Round 1, so why is Macroon lying about being in the Reactor to frame Ian?

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: I can confirm Alice, Bob, and Liam's accounts because I also saw Macroon in the Cafeteria during Round 1 and moving toward Medbay in Round 3, so why is Macroon lying about their location to frame Ian?
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: Macroon is clearly lying to frame me, as I never went to Security and actually saw him move from Medbay to the Upper Engine in Round 4 and then to the Reactor in Round 5.
chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: I can confirm Alice, Bob, Liam, and Mona's accounts since I also saw Macroon in the Cafeteria and then Medbay, so why is he lying about being in the Reactor to frame Ian?

chat: Discussion: [Oscar]: I can confirm Alice, Bob, Liam, and Mona are telling the truth since I also saw Macroon in the Cafeteria during Rounds 1 and 2, so it's a huge red flag that he's lying about being in the Reactor just to frame Ian.
Discussion: [System]: You have 2 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: I honestly don't know why everyone thinks I'm lying since I was just moving around doing tasks and lost track of my exact path, but since I reported the body I was clearly trying to help so let's stop focusing on my vague memory and vote out Ian, who had the only direct path to Security.
chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Since Oscar just confirmed Macroon was in the Cafeteria, I agree that his claim about being in the Reactor is suspicious, so I'm voting to eject Macroon.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Reporting the body doesn't prove innocence, and since Bob, Liam, Mona, Charlie, and Oscar all confirmed Macroon lied about his location to frame Ian, we should eject Macroon now.
chat: Discussion: [Bob]: Macroon's claim of "losing track" is a poor excuse for a deliberate lie to frame Ian, and since almost everyone here has confirmed his location, we must eject him.

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: Macroon's excuse about losing track of his path is completely unbelievable given that so many of us saw him in the Cafeteria and Medbay, and his immediate attempt to frame Ian is a huge red flag, so I vote to eject Macroon.

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: I strongly agree with Alice, Bob, and Liam; Macroon's excuse of "losing track" is completely unbelievable given the overwhelming evidence that he lied about his location to frame Ian, so I vote to eject Macroon.
chat: Discussion: [Ian]: Macroon's "vague memory" is a pathetic excuse for a blatant lie to frame me, and since almost everyone has caught him in that lie, we must eject him now.

chat: Discussion: [Charlie]: Macroon's "vague memory" is a pathetic excuse when almost everyone here saw him in the Cafeteria and Medbay, and reporting the body doesn't excuse his blatant attempt to frame Ian, so I vote to eject Macroon.

chat: Discussion: [Oscar]: A "vague memory" doesn't explain why you specifically claimed to be in the Reactor when six of us saw you elsewhere, so I'm voting to eject Macroon for lying and attempting to frame Ian.
Discussion: [System]: You have 1 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Macroon]: Ian's direct route to Security is the only concrete link to the crime scene, so I was tailing him and only claimed the Reactor to throw him off my scent, which explains why Eren is throwing me under the bus to cover for Ian.

chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Macroon's claim that I'm covering for Ian is completely baseless since I'm simply following the overwhelming evidence everyone else has presented, so we should stick with ejecting him for his blatant lies and desperate frame job, though I remain open to hearing any concrete alibis for Ian before the final vote.

chat: Discussion: [Alice]: Macroon's story is changing rapidly from "losing track" to "throwing Ian off his scent," and this inconsistency, combined with his desperate attempt to drag Eren into the suspicion, is a classic impostor tactic to create confusion.

chat: Discussion: [Bob]: Macroon's story has shifted from "vague memory" to "tailing Ian," proving he is just making things up as he goes and desperately trying to drag Eren into this now that his lies have been exposed.

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: Macroon's story has shifted for the third time—from being in the Reactor to having a "vague memory" and now claiming he was "tailing Ian"—which is a clear sign of an impostor lying on the fly and desperately trying to implicate Eren just because Eren stopped supporting him.

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: It's impossible to "lose track" of your location and "tail" someone at the same time, and Macroon's desperate attempt to implicate Eren just because he lost his support is a clear sign he's lying to survive, so I vote to eject Macroon.
